item.title: Very Good, Even When We Cannot See Why | Rabbenu Avraham on Parashat Bereshit
item.description:
Why does the Torah add "very good" at the end of creation, and why is the soul given by Hashem breathing? The first two ideas in a new weekly series on Rabbenu Avraham's commentary.
Rabbenu Avraham ben HaRambam wrote a commentary on the Torah, of which only Bereshit and Shemot survive. Each week at the Monday HaMaspik shiur, Dayan Daniel Kada shares ideas from it on the parashah.
From HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem 10.1 (full shiur): https://youtu.be/KpEWXoLPY4g
Notes based on the transcript - https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NWtPpEnDousglNcCkeAFDi7YkX9WHlUw7tdhYL9BUy0/edit?usp=sharing
Transcript of the full shiur - https://app.sofer.ai/transcript/109b201d-589f-4027-8ee4-44d5423438af

item.title: What Did Sarah See? Yishmael, Hagar and a Conditional Promise | Rabbenu Avraham on Parashat Vayera
item.description:
Four ideas on Vayera: what Sarah saw when Yishmael was "mesahek", why Hagar feared for Yishmael after the promise, the simple meaning of "where he is", and a principle for reading the whole Torah.
Rabbenu Avraham ben HaRambam wrote a commentary on the Torah, of which only Bereshit and Shemot survive. Each week at the Monday HaMaspik shiur, Dayan Daniel Kada shares ideas from it on the parashah.

item.title: Coming Back, Not Going Out: Yishak at Beer Lahai Roi | Rabbenu Avraham on Parashat Hayyei Sarah
item.description:
Why was Yishak coming back from Beer Lahai Roi when he met Rivkah, and why did he move there only after Avraham died?
Rabbenu Avraham ben HaRambam wrote a commentary on the Torah, of which only Bereshit and Shemot survive. Each week at the Monday HaMaspik shiur, Dayan Daniel Kada shares ideas from it on the parashah.
